droid.notes: Devin bridge caps swe-2 at two concurrent calls, so Droid never runs wider than two trials.

amp.notes: Amp takes --model <route> and --effort <level>; no plugin and no mode label.

claude.notes: Traffic goes through the identity shim on 20140 so Devin accepts the request.

codex.notes: OpenAI Codex CLI. Takes --model and -c model_reasoning_effort; 9Router OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
